Eve and Peabody walked to the apartment building, discussing the case and the potential motives of the suspects. They were particularly interested in Greg Barney, who had been seen carrying a mysterious box out of the apartment and had shown nervous behavior when questioned.

When they arrived at the apartment, they found that Becca had brought over some of Shauna's belongings and had cleared out the food to prevent spoilage. Shauna was not present, but Eve and Peabody were given permission to search the apartment again to ensure that they didn't miss anything.

As they began to search, Eve and Peabody discussed their theories and suspicions about the case. They were both convinced that either Lopez or Barney was involved, but they couldn't quite pinpoint which one.

Suddenly, Peabody had an idea. "Wait a minute," she said. "What if they're not just acting alone? What if they're working together?"

Eve's eyes widened in surprise. "That's a good point. We've been assuming that one of them was the killer, but what if they're both in on it?"

Peabody nodded. "It would explain a lot. They could be using each other as alibis and covering each other's tracks."

Eve's mind was racing with possibilities. "We need to look at their alibis again, see if there's any overlap or inconsistencies. And we need to talk to them again, this time together."

Peabody nodded in agreement. "Let's do it."

As they continued to search the apartment, Eve and Peabody were interrupted by a knock at the door. It was Shauna, who had come to talk to them before the memorial.

"I'm sorry to interrupt," Shauna said, looking pale and tired. "But I wanted to talk to you before the memorial. I know this is a hard day, but I need to know what's going on."

Eve and Peabody exchanged a sympathetic glance. "We're doing everything we can to find out who killed Erin," Eve said gently. "But we need your help. We need to search the apartment again to make sure we don't miss anything."

Shauna nodded, looking determined. "I'll let you in. But please, be quick. I need to get ready for the memorial."

Eve and Peabody nodded, and Shauna led them into the apartment. As they began to search, Eve couldn't help but feel a sense of unease. Something didn't feel right, and she couldn't shake the feeling that they were missing something crucial.

"Peabody, I think we need to take a closer look at the security footage," Eve said, her voice low and urgent. "See if we can find any inconsistencies or clues that might point to the killer."

Peabody nodded, her eyes scanning the room. "I'll get on it right away. But I think we should also talk to Becca and Greg again. They might know something they're not telling us."

Eve's eyes narrowed. "I agree. Let's get to the bottom of this."

As they continued to search the apartment, Eve and Peabody were determined to uncover the truth behind Erin's murder and bring the killer to justice.

Chapter 19

Eve and Peabody decided to pay a visit to Becca and Greg's apartment to ask them some more questions. As they arrived, they noticed that Greg was acting nervously, glancing around the room and avoiding eye contact.

"What's going on?" Eve asked, her eyes narrowing. "You're not hiding something from us, are you?"

Greg shook his head, but Eve wasn't convinced. "I don't know what you're talking about," he said, trying to sound nonchalant.

Peabody stepped forward, her voice firm. "Don't play dumb with us, Greg. We know you were acting suspiciously when we talked to you before. What are you hiding?"

Greg sighed, looking defeated. "Okay, fine. I'll tell you. But you have to promise not to tell Shauna."

Eve and Peabody exchanged a skeptical glance, but Greg's words piqued their interest. "What is it?" Eve asked, her voice softening.

Greg took a deep breath before speaking. "I might have taken something from the apartment. I know it was wrong, but I was in a rush and I didn't think. I didn't mean to cause any trouble."

Eve's eyes locked onto Greg's, her mind racing with possibilities. "What did you take?" she asked, her voice firm.

Greg hesitated, looking around the room nervously before answering. "A small box. I think it might have been something important to Shauna."

Peabody's eyes widened in surprise. "What did you do with it?"

Greg shrugged. "I don't know. I think I might have left it in my car."

Eve's eyes narrowed. "We'll need to search your car and your apartment. And we'll need to ask Shauna about the box."

Greg nodded, looking defeated. "I knew I was in trouble when I saw you guys at the door."

As they continued to question Greg, Eve and Peabody were determined to get to the bottom of the mystery and uncover the truth behind Erin's murder.
